sources.intro: Catavento brings together public information from many places. Every record shows where it came from and when it was checked. This page lists every source, what we use from it, how often we check it, and the credit we show.
sources.thanks: Thank you to the people behind this information: the volunteers who keep the site guides up to date, the clubs and associations that look after flying sites, ParaglidingEarth's contributors, and everyone who runs a weather station. Catavento simply brings their work together in one place.
sources.tierGreenText: Public directories, openly licensed data and official services. We show the facts with a credit and a link.
sources.tierAmberText: Public but run by volunteers, without published terms, or sensitive to traffic. We take only facts and short labels, link to the full content, check rarely, and tell the owner what we use.
sources.tierRedText: Their terms don't allow automated collection, or the content needs a login. We collect nothing and only link to them.
sources.creditNote: Words in italics are filled in for each record, for example the club's name.
sources.changesText: If you look after one of these sources and would like us to change or stop using anything, tell us and we'll act on it, usually within 24 hours.

bot.intro: CataventoBot is the program that collects public information for Catavento. It is built to be a polite visitor: it takes only short facts, checks rarely, and stays away from anything it is asked not to read.
bot.identityText: Every request it makes carries this user agent:

rules.robots: It reads each website's robots.txt first and obeys it. If robots.txt can't be read because of a server error, it doesn't visit.
rules.pace: It makes one request at a time to each website, at least 3 seconds apart.
rules.rarely: It checks each source on a schedule of days or weeks, not continuously. If a file hasn't changed, nothing is updated.
rules.noLogin: It never logs in, never sends cookies, and never fills in forms.
rules.facts: It takes facts and short labels, such as names, coordinates, wind directions and links. It never copies descriptions, articles or photos.
rules.guard: If a source suddenly looks very different, the update is held back for a person to check.

bot.scheduleHeading: What it collects, and how often
bot.scheduleText: These are the sources it currently collects from. The Sources page lists everything Catavento uses, including what is only linked to.
bot.noneYet: Nothing is being collected automatically at the moment.
bot.optOutText: To stop CataventoBot visiting your website, add these lines to your robots.txt. It will stop at its next scheduled check.
bot.optOutContact: Or email us and we'll stop, usually within 24 hours. We can also remove anything already collected from your site.

ntf.hubIntro: Flying under a paraglider or hang glider is closer than most people think. Start with a tandem flight with an instructor, or learn to fly yourself with a school.
ntf.gloss: (Catavento means pinwheel: it catches the wind.)
ntf.tandemButtonText: Fly with an experienced pilot. No training needed.
ntf.learnButtonText: Train with a school towards your own licence.
ntf.howLearningText: Most people start with a tandem flight or an introduction day. If you want to keep going, you train with a school listed by the national body towards your first licence, join the national body, and then join a club to fly its sites with experienced pilots around you.
ntf.sampleNote: New Zealand is a sample, so this section shows the tandem and school listings and a short pathway only.
ntf.tandemIntro: A tandem is a flight with an experienced pilot, sharing one wing. You don't need any training.
ntf.tandemSchoolsNote: Many schools also fly tandems. Ask them.
ntf.tandemNone: No tandem flights listed in {region} yet.
ntf.expect1: Tandem flights depend on the weather, so be ready to move your booking.
ntf.expect2: How flexible bookings are varies by operator: check when you book.
ntf.expect3: Weight and age limits vary: check with the operator.
ntf.learnIntro: Learning to fly is a series of steps, each with people to help you.
ntf.stepTandem: Try a tandem or an introduction day.
ntf.stepCourse: Take a licence course with a school listed by {body}.
ntf.stepClub: Join a club and fly its sites with mentors.
ntf.pgSummary: A fabric wing you launch on foot from a hill or by tow. Light enough to carry in a backpack.
ntf.hgSummary: A rigid wing you hold above you, launched on foot from a hill or by tow. Hang gliders fly faster than paragliders.
ntf.ppgSummary: A paraglider with a small motor on your back, so you can take off from flat ground.
ntf.pgText: A paraglider is a fabric wing with no rigid parts. You sit in a harness below it and steer with brake lines. Pilots launch on foot from a hill or are towed up, and can stay up for hours in rising air. Everything packs into a backpack.
ntf.hgText: A hang glider is a rigid wing on an aluminium frame. You lie in a harness below it and steer by moving your weight against a control bar. Hang gliders fly faster than paragliders and handle stronger winds. They're launched on foot from a hill or by tow, and carried on a car roof.
ntf.ppgText: A paramotor is a paraglider with a small engine and propeller worn on your back. Because the motor gives you the climb, you can take off from flat ground rather than a hill.
ntf.courseFormatText: Course length, format and what's included vary from school to school. See each school's website, or ask them.
ntf.choosingIntro: A few things worth asking before you book a course:
ntf.choose1: Where are its training sites, and how far are they from you?
ntf.choose2: Does it teach the kind of flying you want: paragliding, hang gliding or paramotoring?
ntf.choose3: How is the course run: over consecutive days, weekends or as the weather allows?
ntf.choose5: Do you use the school's equipment, and what are the terms if you buy your own?
ntf.choose7: Talk to the instructor before you book.
ntf.costsIntro: Prices change, and most schools publish them on their own websites. We only show prices a school has published, with where and when we saw them.
ntf.costsNone: Contact the school for current prices.
ntf.schoolsIntro: Schools listed by the national body and in our directory. Pick up to three to compare.
ntf.compareLimit: You can compare up to 3 schools.

gear.usedIntro: Used gear can be a good way to start, as long as it suits you and is in good condition. Before you buy, check:
gear.used1: the wing's certification class, and that its weight range suits you;
gear.used2: its age and how many hours it has flown;
gear.used3: when its lines and fabric (porosity) were last checked;
gear.used4: when the reserve parachute was last repacked;
gear.used5: whether it has been in any incident.

about.whatText: Catavento is a free, independent directory of paragliding and hang gliding: flying sites and who manages them, clubs, schools and tandem flights, shops, events and safety notices. It brings together information that's already public, says where each piece comes from, and links to the official source.
about.independentText: Catavento isn't affiliated with any national body, site guide, club, school or business. Being listed here isn't an endorsement, and no one pays to be listed.
about.prototypeText: Catavento is being shared with pilots, clubs and schools to find out what's useful. Information may be incomplete or out of date: always check the official source before you fly.
about.sourcesText: Every page lists its sources. See Sources for each one we use, Status for when each was last checked, and Bot policy for how we collect it.
about.feedbackText: What's useful, what's wrong and what's missing: we read everything.

privacy.intro: Catavento doesn't know who you are, and it doesn't want to.
privacy.accountsText: You don't sign up for anything. Catavento doesn't set cookies, track you or run analytics.
privacy.deviceHeading: Your saved sites stay on your device
privacy.deviceText: My Sites, your units and your speed limits are kept in your browser's storage on this device. They're never sent to us. Clearing your browser's data for this site removes them. A “Share my list” link contains only the sites' IDs.
privacy.servicesIntro: Some features load from other services, straight from your browser. Like any website, each of them can see your browser's internet address.
privacy.openMeteo: Open-Meteo, for wind forecasts, whenever a page shows an outlook. The request contains the site's position, nothing about you.
privacy.openFreeMap: OpenFreeMap, for map tiles, whenever a page shows a map.
privacy.windy: Windy, for its live wind map, only after you tap “Show live wind map”. Windy may set its own cookies.
privacy.links: Links to weather stations, clubs, schools and other sites take you to those sites, under their own privacy policies.
privacy.feedbackText: Our feedback and correction forms are Google Forms. Your answers go to the project's private Google Sheets. We ask for your email only if you'd like a reply, and we never publish anyone's name or email.
privacy.hostingText: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub logs visitors' internet addresses for security; we don't see or use those logs.
privacy.peopleText: We list organisations, not people. We don't copy committee members' names or personal contact details, even where a source publishes them.

takedown.intro: If anything here is wrong, or you'd like us to stop using something, tell us. We'll act on it, usually within 24 hours.
takedown.what1: Anything that's wrong or out of date.
takedown.what2: Anything about you, your club, school or business that you'd rather wasn't here.
takedown.what3: Anything a source asks us to stop using.
takedown.howText: Use “Report a correction” at the bottom of any page, or email us. Include the page's address and what should change.
takedown.ownersText: To stop CataventoBot visiting your website, see the Bot policy.

disclaimer.officialText: Catavento is independent and isn't affiliated with any national body, site guide, club, school or business. Site information is copied from public sources and may be out of date. The official site guide and the body managing a site have the final word.
disclaimer.forecastText: The outlook compares forecast wind direction with each site's published wind range. It doesn't take into account wind strength, gusts, thermals, cloud, rain, airspace or your experience, and forecasts can be wrong.
disclaimer.listingsText: A listing isn't an endorsement or a recommendation. “Listed by” a national body means only that the national body's own directory lists it.
disclaimer.adviceText: Nothing here is flying instruction or legal advice.

testers.heading: Helping test Catavento?
testers.intro: Thank you. Here are some things to try, in any order:
testers.t1: Find a site you know. Check its details, wind range and who manages it.
testers.t2: Star a few sites, then open My Sites and look at the 3-day outlook.
testers.t3: Look up your club, and tell us if anything's wrong or missing.
testers.t4: Try New to flying as if you'd never flown. Does it make sense?
testers.t5: On your phone, add Catavento to your home screen.
testers.t6: Search for a site, club or school.
testers.outro: Then tell us what was useful, what was wrong and what's missing.
